title: Street Litter

items.label: Open Gutter
items.description: Light food packaging blows into an uncovered street gutter.
items.visual_focus: a wrapper blowing into an open roadside gutter
items.local_cue: a Bangladeshi snack wrapper beside a concrete street drain and small shopfront

items.label: Full Bin
items.description: A person tries to put a cup into an overflowing roadside bin.
items.visual_focus: a bin filled above the rim while a person holds one more cup
items.local_cue: a small roadside rubbish bin beside a Rajshahi tea stall, full of paper cups

items.label: Sweeping Cups
items.description: A stall worker sweeps disposable cups from the pavement into the gutter.
items.visual_focus: a broom pushing used cups off the pavement toward the gutter
items.local_cue: used tea cups on a paved bazaar footpath beside a concrete gutter

items.label: Fruit Peels
items.description: A shopper drops fruit peels beside a busy stall.
items.visual_focus: a shopper's hand dropping fruit peels beside a stall
items.local_cue: fruit peels beside a Bangladeshi produce stall with a hanging weighing scale

items.label: Mixed Waste
items.description: A collector lifts one bag containing food scraps and plastic together.
items.visual_focus: food scraps and plastic visible together in the same lifted bag
items.local_cue: a waste bag holding fruit peels and plastic cups beside a produce stall

items.label: Carrying Waste
items.description: A vendor carries a full waste bag past several stalls toward a collection cart far down the lane.
items.visual_focus: a vendor carrying a full waste bag toward a distant collection cart
items.local_cue: a Rajshahi bazaar vendor carrying a sack to a small hand-pulled collection cart

questions: Which two scenes could spread litter fastest?
Where do you notice litter on a route you use in Rajshahi?
Should a stall worker or a shopper deal with a used cup? Why?
Why might a vendor sweep waste into the gutter?
If extra bins appear, who will empty them and when?
You have 100,000 BDT and 30 days. What one waste-handling change would your grant test?

grant.pilot_scope: Trial waste containers and a collection agreement with one stall cluster.
